name: chatgpt-chrome-bridge
description: Give Codex context-isolated ChatGPT reasoning and exact-thread follow-ups through a signed-in Chrome profile.

interface.longDescription: Gives Codex a parallel, context-isolated account-backed ChatGPT worker for deep reasoning, research, analysis, synthesis, critique, generic planning, safe repository snapshots, generated artifacts, and exact-thread follow-up conversations. ChatGPT receives only the submitted prompt plus exact user-authorized attachments and cannot see the Codex conversation, project, repository, unlisted files, terminal, local UI, or other agents. A follow-up additionally receives that selected website conversation's own history and returns a fresh job ID with reply lineage. The bridge binds to a configured Chrome profile directory instead of whichever profile is focused, dynamically discovers current account options, launches isolated Chrome off-screen without stealing focus, globally paces actual submissions, supports concurrent queues with durable status calls, provides browser inspection as a recovery fail-safe, and closes its idle worker browser after preserving verified refreshed login state. Same-thread replies are serialized locally and through a heartbeat-backed shared lease while unrelated work remains parallel. Terminal local metadata and internal inspection screenshots are automatically age/count bounded without deleting account chats or downloaded deliverables. The bridge leaves ChatGPT's current/default model unchanged and exposes only thinking effort, expanding the Advanced menu when needed. It creates reviewed secret-scanned repository ZIPs, retrieves generated response files, defaults to Extra High reasoning, and files new chats in the optionally configured ChatGPT project.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a self-contained general research workstream to ChatGPT
Continue a completed ChatGPT answer with a follow-up
Ask ChatGPT to analyze an explicitly attached file
